decision.horizon: through NVDA Q2 FY2027 earnings Aug 26 and beyond; buyback (40T won, 24M shares, Aug 20–Nov 19) provides structural demand floor above ₩1,483,000 gate; step-aside only on close below ₩1,483,000 (gate buffer now ₩208,000 / 14.0%)
decision.rationale: Upgraded from HOLD LOW to BUY HIGH on the buyback announcement. The 40 trillion won ($28.6B) buyback and cancellation program running Aug 20–Nov 19 fundamentally changes the risk profile: (1) SK Hynix is now an active buyer of its own shares in the open market daily through Nov 19 — the company is structurally defending the price floor; (2) Gate buffer rebuilt from ₩25,000 / 1.7% (the narrowest in the framework's re-entry history) to ₩208,000 / 14.0% in a single session; (3) The step-aside gate (₩1,483,000) now has the company's buyback demand as an additional defense layer; (4) Q2 results (record revenue ₩79.3T, 76% operating margin) confirm the cash generation thesis that enabled the buyback; (5) HBM4 mass shipments to NVIDIA ongoing; (6) 6 days to the NVDA Aug 26 earnings binary — the framework's primary catalyst for additional upside. The company-announced buyback is the most powerful anti-gate-breach mechanism available: it turns institutional sellers into structural buyers.

so_what.line: Gate scare resolved: 40T won buyback sent shares +12.14% to ₩1,691,000, gate buffer rebuilt from ₩25,000 to ₩208,000, decision upgraded from HOLD LOW to BUY HIGH — the framework entry from ₩1,504,000 (Aug 12) is now +12.4% profitable.
so_what.bull: Yesterday's ₩25,000 / 1.7% gate buffer was not a margin of safety — it was a single bad open away from step-aside. Today's 40T won buyback announcement eliminated that risk: SK Hynix is now an active buyer of 24M shares through Nov 19, creating a structural price floor that the open market cannot easily overwhelm. The Q2 results (₩79.3T revenue, 76% operating margin) confirm the cash generation that makes the buyback sustainable. JPMorgan says the company could add another $130B in total returns. The framework re-entry at ₩1,504,000 (Aug 12) is now +12.4% profitable — a recovery that vindicated holding through yesterday's gate-scare.
so_what.bear: The +12.14% one-day surge brings SK Hynix back to ₩1,691,000 — only ₩29,000 above the Aug 13 close (₩1,662,000 corrected Aug 18 close). The stock has been in a volatile ₩1,483,000–₩1,719,000 range since Aug 19. The buyback sets a floor, but if NVDA Aug 26 earnings disappoint (miss or weak Q3 guide), SK Hynix could re-test ₩1,600,000-₩1,640,000 even with the buyback active. The 30-year US Treasury yield remains elevated (~5.20-5.25%) — the AI infrastructure NPV headwind is not eliminated by the buyback.

extra.label: ★ THE BUYBACK: 40T Won ($28.6B), 24M Shares (~3.3% of Outstanding), Aug 20–Nov 19 — Largest Treasury-Share Cancellation in Listed Korean Corporate History
extra.value: SK Hynix filed regulatory disclosure Aug 20 to buy back and cancel 24,074,923 shares over Aug 20–Nov 19, 2026 at a cost of 40 trillion won ($28.6 billion). Key details per Bloomberg, CNBC, and SK Hynix Newsroom: (1) 40 TRILLION WON — Korea's largest ever treasury-share cancellation by a listed company; (2) 24 MILLION SHARES — approximately 3.3% of outstanding shares; (3) AUG 20 – NOV 19 DURATION — active buyback demand in the market daily for 91 days; (4) SHAREHOLDER RETURN PLEDGE RAISED — 'more than 50% of cumulative free cash flow from 2025 to 2027' (~$170B total commitment); (5) CANCELLATION — not just repurchase; cancelled shares reduce share count permanently, improving EPS and per-share metrics; (6) JPMORGAN: 'SK Hynix May Add Another $130 Billion to Returns' — the buyback is framed as a floor, not a ceiling.

extra.label: GATE BUFFER REBUILT: ₩25,000 / 1.7% (Yesterday's Danger Zone) → ₩208,000 / 14.0% (Today's Close) in One Session
extra.value: The most dramatic gate-buffer single-session swing in the framework's history: Yesterday (Aug 19): close ₩1,508,000, gate buffer ₩25,000 / 1.7% — the narrowest ever; session low ₩1,501,000 was only ₩18,000 above step-aside. Today (Aug 20): close ₩1,691,000, gate buffer ₩208,000 / 14.0%. The ₩183,000 / +12.14% advance rebuilt the buffer in a single session to its most comfortable level since Aug 17. The company's active buyback authorization (40T won, Aug 20-Nov 19) acts as an additional defense layer: if the market attempts to push SK Hynix toward ₩1,483,000, it now faces the company's own buy orders as structural support.

extra.label: Q2 2026 RECORD RESULTS CONFIRMED: Revenue ₩79.3T (+257% YoY), Operating Profit ₩60.5T (+557% YoY), Operating Margin 76% — Buyback Sized at 57.6% of Q2 Net Cash
extra.value: The 40T won buyback represents 57.6% of SK Hynix's net cash from Q2 2026 — a signal that Q2 cash generation was extraordinary. Q2 confirmed results: Revenue ₩79.3187T ($65.5B, +257% YoY), Operating Profit ₩60.5426T ($50.3B, +557% YoY), Operating Margin 76%. These numbers are driven by HBM4 mass shipments to NVIDIA and the ramp of the AI memory supply chain. The company has sufficient cash generation to sustain a $28.6B buyback while maintaining the ₩54.3T capex plan through 2031 and the >50% FCF shareholder return commitment. This is not a leveraged buyback — it is being funded from organic cash flow.

extra.label: JPMORGAN: SK HYNIX COULD ADD ANOTHER $130B IN RETURNS — Buyback Is the Floor, Not the Ceiling; Market Response Confirms Structural Discount Was Excessive
extra.value: JPMorgan published Aug 20 that SK Hynix 'May Add Another $130 Billion to Returns' beyond the 40T won already announced — citing the FCF commitment of >50% of 2025-2027 cumulative FCF (~$170B total). The Bloomberg headline: 'SK Hynix May Add Another $130 Billion to Returns, JPMorgan Says.' The CNBC headline: 'South Korea's SK Hynix plans massive stock buyback.' analysis:
## Technical analysis

### The Buyback Session — Gate Risk Eliminated, Framework Upgraded to BUY HIGH

Aug 20 is the most significant positive session in the SK Hynix framework since the Aug 12 re-entry. The 40 trillion won buyback announcement ($28.6B, 24M shares, Aug 20–Nov 19) achieved in one session what the Aug 12-18 bull run took seven sessions to build: a comfortable gate buffer.

### Gate Buffer History — Compressed and Rebuilt

| Date | Close | Gate Buffer (vs ₩1,483,000) | Notes |
|------|-------|----------------------------|-------|
| Aug 12 (re-entry) | ₩1,504,000 | +₩21,000 / +1.4% | Re-entry |
| Aug 17 | ₩1,645,000 | +₩162,000 / +10.9% | Peak expansion |
| Aug 18 (actual) | ₩1,662,000 | +₩179,000 / +12.1% | |
| Aug 19 (DANGER) | ₩1,508,000 | **+₩25,000 / +1.7%** | Narrowest ever |
| **Aug 20 (today)** | **₩1,691,000** | **+₩208,000 / +14.0%** | **Rebuilt** |

### Structural Change: Company as Active Buyer

The buyback changes the technical picture in a way a price rally alone cannot: SK Hynix is now authorized and obligated to spend up to 40T won buying its own shares in the open market through Nov 19. This creates:

1. **Daily structural demand** — the company places open-market buy orders every session
2. **Asymmetric gate defense** — if SK Hynix approaches ₩1,483,000, the company's buy orders (sized at ~260,000 shares/day on average across 91 days) provide systematic buying support
3. **Short deterrence** — shorting against a $28.6B buyback authorization requires fighting the company's own balance sheet
4. **Psychological anchor** — the buyback signals management confidence in the stock's fundamental value at current prices

### The Aug 18 Ceiling (₩1,662,000) Is Now Support

Yesterday's dossier identified ₩1,662,000 (actual Aug 18 close) as '★ Strongest resistance — the primary overhead resistance after today's -9.27% gap-down.' Today's ₩1,691,000 close reclaims above ₩1,662,000 — the former resistance is now support. This mirrors the resistance-to-support pattern identified for BTC's $65,000-$65,500 zone.

### ★ Strongest Support — ₩1,483,000 (Framework Gate, Now Buyback-Defended)

The gate has never been stronger as a support level:
1. ₩208,000 / 14.0% buffer above it (vs ₩25,000 / 1.7% yesterday)
2. 40T won in company buyback authorization provides systematic buying above the gate
3. Record Q2 cash generation (₩60.5T operating profit, 76% margin) confirms the buyback is funded
4. The gate at ₩1,483,000 is mechanically still the framework's step-aside trigger — the buyback makes it more robust, not different

### ★ Strongest Resistance — ₩1,867,213 (52-Week High)

With the gate buffer rebuilt and the decision upgraded to BUY HIGH, the 52-week high (₩1,867,213) becomes the primary bull target:
- ₩176,213 / +10.4% above today's close
- Reachable post-NVDA Aug 26 beat (historical SK Hynix move on strong NVDA earnings: +5-10% in one session)
- A single strong NVDA earnings session could move SK Hynix from ₩1,691,000 to ₩1,800,000-₩1,860,000, approaching the 52-week high

### Volume Analysis

Volume was extremely elevated on the buyback announcement — broker order limits were triggered at one domestic brokerage (Korea Herald: 'broker hits limit'), indicating retail order flow was so heavy that system capacities were tested. High volume on a +12.14% surge is constructive: it represents broad institutional and retail participation, not a thin-tape spike.

### What Would Change the Read

**Extend BUY HIGH:** NVDA Aug 26 beat gaps SK Hynix toward ₩1,800,000-₩1,867,213; additional buyback measures at Q3 earnings; 30-yr yields stabilize below 5.20%.

**Step-Aside (unchanged trigger):** Close at or below ₩1,483,000 — now ₩208,000 / 14.0% away; a close here would require a -12.3% session from today, which is extreme but not impossible in a macro shock scenario.
